text.tspan: Module 2 — The Ccnd1 locus: PRC2 / H3K27me3 brake on Cyclin D1
EZH2 (cell-cycle-coupled writer) → PRC2 → me1 → me2 → me3 at the promoter; Gli-induced eraser; transcription evicts PRC2; S phase halves the mark; repression is leaky
cycle-coupled writer: EZH2 rises in S/G2,
falls when cells exit the cycle
eraser strips me3 → me2 → me1 (MB: high Gli1 → less mark than GNP)
writer follows the CYCLE, eraser follows MITOGEN:
EED reads me3 → recruits more PRC2 (read-write, self-reinforcing)
blocks the SET domain (WRITING) only — PRC2 stays bound,
existing mark decays over ~1 day (turnover + eraser + dilution)
LEAKY: dampens, never silences (Pol II stays)
double-negative: active locus stays poised; vismodegib arrest self-reinforces
